title: Finance, Unit Economics & Valuation
rules: Gross margin must be stated per plan tier after payment and inference costs.
CAC payback under 12 months; LTV/CAC above 3 for sustainable growth.
Model burn with three scenarios: base, slow growth, churn shock.
Price on value metric, not on seats, when usage correlates with value.
Every valuation claim needs an anti-thesis: what makes it 50% lower?
Track net revenue retention per cohort, not blended averages.
Inference cost per active user is a first-class unit-economics line.
redFlags: unlimited free tier with frontier-model costs
checklist: Is there a one-page unit-economics model with formulas, not numbers only?
Are inference costs attributed per feature and per user?
Is there a break-even chart with current burn?
Are top-3 investor objections written down with data-backed responses?
Is there a pricing experiment backlog?

scoringRubric.1-3: Blind: no unit economics, unbounded variable costs, blended-only metrics.
scoringRubric.4-6: Directional: rough model, missing cohort detail, untested pricing.
scoringRubric.7-8: Solid: per-cohort NRR, CAC payback modeled, cost attribution, valuation anti-theses.
scoringRubric.9-10: Investor-grade: scenario-tested model, verified cohorts, price experiment cadence.
